channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Nato launches new Arctic mission weeks after Trump’s Greenland threats
item.description: Is Nato's new mission to protect the Arctic region Donald Trump's ladder to climb down, following his threats to invade Greenland? As Georg von Harrach explains, European allies hope he will take it.

item.title: Footage from ‘spycam’ in Epstein’s Palm Beach home verified by Channel 4 News – exclusive
item.description: Channel 4 News has verified spycam footage inside Jeffrey Epstein's living room, which appears to show the sex offender recording himself with potential victims.

item.title: ‘They are protecting world leaders and Trump’ – Congresswoman on Epstein files redactions
item.description: We spoke to Melanie Stansbury, a Democratic congresswoman from New Mexico who's a member of the House Oversight Committee, which is investigating the Epstein files.

item.title: Epstein victims face US attorney general at Congress hearing
item.description: The US Attorney general Pam Bondi has faced angry scenes in Congress as she was questioned over her handling of the Epstein files and urged to apologise to survivors.

item.title: ‘Inquiry underway’ into how aide linked to sex offender made peer – culture secretary says
item.description: We spoke to the Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy.

item.title: More scandal for Starmer over vetting of another aide’s links to sex offender
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer was under fire as he faced a storm of questions in the Commons - the Tory leader Kemi Badenoch accused him of putting "paedophile apologists" into positions of power.

item.title: ‘Due diligence vitally important’ in next top civil servant appointment – Lord McDonald
item.description: Another high profile departure from No 10 in the wake of the Mandelson scandal is due to be Britain's top civil servant.

item.title: Canada mourns over ‘one of the worst’ shootings in its history
item.description: Students and teachers have described how they were forced to hide for hours inside their school during a mass shooting which killed nine people and injured 25 others.

item.title: Bangladesh election: Can the country move on from Sheikh Hasina?
item.description: Tomorrow voters in Bangladesh will go to the polls in what many in the country see as the first free and fair elections for more than a decade.

item.title: ‘Netanyahu’s preference’ is for US to bomb Iran – journalist
item.description: The Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu just ended almost three hours of talks with Donald Trump at the White House.
